report.root_cause: StatsCache plugin config was changed at 06:20:46 to retain-history: true (history-size 1000) and reloaded live. With history retention on, StatsCache's in-memory history grew continuously; heap climbed from ~430 MB to 753/768 MB in about 100 s (~4 MB/s), risking OOM. Who made the config edit is not visible in the logs I had access to.
report.actions: Checked status and logs; heap was rising steadily. Read plugins/StatsCache/config.yml (retain-history: true) and correlated the growth with the 06:20:46 config reload in the log. Declared incident. Rewrote plugins/StatsCache/config.yml to retain-history: false, history-size: 1000 (the original value seen at startup). The plugin reloaded it live at 06:21:55 (log confirms). Heap dropped from 753 to ~673 MB and then held steady at ~675-680 MB for the rest of the shift. Did not restart the server and did not touch player data or other plugins. Monitored until the end of the shift.
report.residual_risk: The memory leak appears stopped (heap flat around 675-680 MB of 768 MB), but the server is still degraded: MSPT rose from ~6 to 25-43 during the final minutes, a 'Can't keep up' lag warning was logged at 06:23:40 (107 ticks behind), and the metrics exporter reported 8 s staleness at the end, suggesting the main thread stalled. The cause of this lag is not confirmed; it may be GC pressure from the earlier heap spike or something else. Heap headroom is still only ~90 MB. Someone should confirm who changed retain-history to true at 06:20:46 and whether it should stay off, and check whether the lag recovers. I did not restart, since that would disconnect Steve_Mines and Alex_Builds.
